accounts_agent_fields_check.name: accounts_agent_fields_check
accounts_agent_fields_check.value:
("accounts"."kind" = 'human' and "accounts"."description" is null and "accounts"."all_projects" is null)
        or ("accounts"."kind" = 'agent' and "accounts"."all_projects" is not null)

accounts_description_length_check.name: accounts_description_length_check
accounts_description_length_check.value: "accounts"."description" is null or char_length("accounts"."description") between 1 and 500

bug_reports_run_id_check.name: bug_reports_run_id_check
bug_reports_run_id_check.value: "bug_reports"."run_id" is null or char_length("bug_reports"."run_id") between 1 and 128

epics_dates_ordered.name: epics_dates_ordered
epics_dates_ordered.value: "epics"."start_date" is null or "epics"."target_date" is null or "epics"."target_date" >= "epics"."start_date"

tasks_fingerprint_check.name: tasks_fingerprint_check
tasks_fingerprint_check.value: "tasks"."fingerprint" is null or char_length("tasks"."fingerprint") between 1 and 128
